Cultist Sacrifice.effect: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for **170% Bonus Souls** and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

Tesla Bullets.effect: Your bullets have a chance to **shock** your target. The **shock** will jump to a nearby enemy.

Capacitor.effect: Your bullets have a chance to **shock** your target. The **shock** will jump to a nearby enemy. Launch a projectile that deals **Spirit Icondamage**, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, **prevents Stamina usage** and **Silences** their **movement-based items and abilities**.

Hollow Point.effect: When you are **above 65% health**, deal additional **Weapon Damage** and your bullets reduce enemy **Bullet Resist**.

Opening Rounds.effect: Your attacks have additional **Weapon Damage** against **enemies above 50% health**.

Melee Lifesteal.note: This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

Rebuttal.effect: On a successful **Parry** against an enemy Hero, **Heal** yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased **damage.**

Counterspell.effect: Your next parry **protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items**. On a successful spell parry Heal and gain Move Speed and Spirit.

Weighted Shots.effect: Your bullets build up a **Movement Slow** on enemies.

Close Quarters.effect: Deal additional **Weapon Damage** when in **close range** to your target.

Long Range.effect: Deal additional **Weapon Damage** when **beyond a minimum distance** from your target.

Slowing Bullets.effect: Your bullets build up a **Movement Slow** on enemies.

Inhibitor.effect: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's **outgoing damage** and apply **healing reduction**.

Spirit Shredder.effect: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the **Spirit Resist** of the target and grants you and your allies **Spirit Lifesteal** against them.

Heroic Aura.effect: Provides **Bullet Resist** to nearby friendly units. Provides **Move Speed** and **Fire Rate** to you and nearby allies. **Minions** get double value.

Silence Wave.effect: Launch an expanding projectile which **Silences** enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.
Silence Wave.note: Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

Silencer.effect: Your bullets reduce the target's **outgoing spirit damage**. Your bullets build up to a **Silence**. Victims are immune to the build up for **10ss** after silence expires.

Berserker.effect: Your **Weapon Damage** increases as you take sustained damage.

Frenzy.effect: While you are **below 50% health**, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

Siphon Bullets.effect: Your bullets temporarily **steal Max HP** from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

Headshot Booster.effect: Your next **headshot** against an enemy Hero deals Bullet Damage.

Sharpshooter.effect: Deal additional **Weapon Damage** when **beyond a minimum distance** from your target.

Headhunter.effect: Your next **headshot** against an enemy Hero deals Bullet Damage, Heal you, and briefly grants Move Speed.

Spirit Rend.effect: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the **Spirit Resist** of the target and grants you and your allies **Spirit Lifesteal** against them. Landing **headshots** against the target reduces their **Spirit Resist** further.

Crippling Headshot.effect: Landing a **Headshot** will reduce their **Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing**.

Mystic Shot.effect: Your next bullet deals bonus Spirit Damage.

Lucky Shot.effect: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal **bonus weapon damage** on hit.

Point Blank.effect: When in **close range** to your target, gain **Weapon Damage** and your bullets apply a **Movement Slow**.

Toxic Bullets.effect: Your bullets build up a **Bleed** on enemies, causing them to lose a **percentage** of their **Max Health** over time. Also reduces **Incoming Healing** on the bleeding target.

Ricochet.effect: Your bullets will **ricochet** on enemies near your target, **applying any bullet procs** and **dealing a percentage of the original damage.**

Debuff Reducer.effect: Reduces the **duration** of all negative effects applied to you.

Dispel Magic.effect: **Purge all non-ultimate negative effects** currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, **heal yourself** and gain a **move speed bonus**.
Dispel Magic.note: Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

Spirit Resilience.effect: When below **50% health**, gain additional Spirit Resist.

Bullet Resilience.effect: When below **50% health**, gain additional **Bullet Resist**.

Fortitude.effect: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen. When you are **above 75% health**, you have bonus **Move Speed**.

Trophy Collector.effect: Whenever you score an **assist or kill**, gain extra **sprint**, **ability range** and **passive soul generation**. This effect stacks and persists through death.

Enduring Speed.effect: Reduces the effect of enemy **Move Speed** penalties.

Stamina Mastery.effect: Allows an additional use of **Air Jump** or **Air Dash** before landing.

Hunter's Aura.effect: Reduces nearby enemies' **Bullet Resist and Fire Rate**. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this **effect is doubled**.

Grit.effect: Gain a **Barrier** for a short duration.

Weapon Shielding.effect: Gain a **Barrier** whenever you take significant Weapon Damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

Spirit Shielding.effect: Gain a **Barrier** whenever you take significant Spirit Damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

Battle Vest.effect: While you are **above 65% health**, gain **Weapon Damage** and **Fire Rate**.

Enchanter's Emblem.effect: While you are **above 65% health**, gain bonus **Spirit** and **Cooldown Reduction**.

Mystic Regeneration.effect: Dealing Spirit Damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus Regen. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

Spiritual Overflow.effect: Gain bonus **Fire Rate**, **Spirit Power** and **Spirit Lifesteal** by **charging up** when shooting enemy heroes.

Return Fire.effect: Automatically **fire a bullet** towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

Greater Expansion.effect: Increases the **range** and **effect radius** of your abilities and items.

Mystic Expansion.effect: Imbue an ability to increase its **range** and **effect radius**.

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

Bullet Resist Shredder.effect: Reduces **Bullet Resist** on enemies when you deal Spirit Damage.

Mystic Reverb.effect: Imbue an ability with **Lifesteal** and to apply **slow** on a hit target and deal an **additional percentage of the damage dealt** to enemies around the target after a short delay.

Mystic Burst.effect: Charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, causing abilities dealing more than **80** damage to deal additional damage.

Tankbuster.effect: Charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, causing abilities dealing more than **165** damage to deal additional damage. **Ignores Spirit Resistance.**

Mystic Vulnerability.effect: When an enemy takes Spirit Damage, they have their Spirit Resist reduced.

Healbane.effect: Your Spirit Damage reduces the enemy's **Incoming Healing**. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

Mystic Slow.effect: When the target takes Spirit Damage, they have their **Move Speed** reduced.

Escalating Exposure.effect: Dealing Spirit Damage applies a stacking **Spirit Amp** that increases your Spirit Damage to the target.

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities
Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

Omnicharge Signet.effect: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with **Bonus Ability Charges**. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

Compress Cooldown.effect: Imbue an ability to reduce its **Cooldown**.

Transcendent Cooldown.effect: Reduces the **Cooldown** of your abilities and items.

Slowing Hex.effect: **Slows movement** of enemy target. Also **Silences** their **movement-based items and abilities**.
Slowing Hex.note: Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

Spirit Sap.effect: Target an enemy to **reduce their Spirit Resist** and **Spirit Power**.

Focus Lens.effect: Target an enemy to **Silence** them. A portion of **all damage dealt** during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

Rusted Barrel.effect: Target an enemy to reduce their **Fire Rate** and **Bullet Resistance**.

Disarming Hex.effect: **Disarms** enemy target and reduces their **Bullet Resist**.

Rescue Beam.effect: **Heals** a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of **Max Health**. Once while healing, you can **Pull** the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

Decay.effect: Inflict **damage over time** to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

Scourge.effect: Apply **Spirit Resist**, **Debuff Resist** and an aura on a friendly target that deals **Spirit Icondamage** to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

Knockdown.effect: Apply a **Stun** after **2ss**. Stun duration is increased against **airborne** targets.
Knockdown.note: Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

Phantom Strike.effect: **Teleport** to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing **damage**, **Move speed** reduction and **Disarm**.

Vortex Web.effect: Throw a **vacuum** grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying **Slowing Hex**.
Vortex Web.note: Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

Refresher.effect: **Reset the cooldown** of all your abilities and **restore all your charges**.

Echo Shard.effect: **Reset the cooldown** of the imbued non-ultimate ability. This item's cooldown is increased by **the cooldown of the imbued ability**.

Torment Pulse.effect: Periodically deals Spirit Damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

Cheat Death.effect: When you would take lethal damage, instead become **temporarily death immune** and **remove all non-stun debuffs**. While death immune, you deal **reduced damage** and have **reduced healing**.

Shadow Weave.effect: Become **Stealthed**. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed. Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an **ambush**, temporarily granting you bonus **Fire Rate**, **Spirit Power** and **Melee Damage**.

Restorative Locket.effect: When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one **Restoration Stack**. Consume all stacks to **heal yourself** and replenish **up to 3 stamina** based on how many stacks you have.

Healing Rite.effect: Grant **Regen** and **Sprint Speed** to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

Shrink Ray.effect: Reduces **Model Size** and grants **Move Speed** to the target. Allows **usage of tunnels** in this mode. Can be self-cast.

Guardian Ward.effect: Provide the target with a **Barrier** and temporary **Move Speed**.
Guardian Ward.note: Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

Divine Barrier.effect: **Remove all non-stun debuffs** from the target and provide them with a **Barrier** and **Move Speed**.
Divine Barrier.note: Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

Alchemical Fire.effect: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing Spirit Damage **per second** and reduces enemy **Bullet Resist**. 50% less effective vs non-heroes.

Blood Tribute.effect: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve Fire Rate, **Debuff Resistance** and **Move Speed**.

Fleetfoot.effect: Removes the **Move Speed** penalty while shooting. Gain bonus **Move Speed** and **Slow Resistance**.

Kinetic Dash.effect: When you **Dash-Jump** you gain **Fire Rate** and bonus **Ammo** until your next reload. Lasts up to 7ss.

Arcane Surge.effect: After you **Dash-Jump**, the **next ability you use** within s will have bonus **Range, Duration,** and **Spirit Power**.

Unstoppable.effect: Temporarily suppress **negative status effects** and become **immune** to **Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm**. Cannot be used while **Stunned** or **Slept**.

Colossus.effect: Grow **larger in size**, gaining Bullet Resist, Spirit Resist, and Melee Damage. Nearby enemies suffer from Slow and have reduced **dash speed**.

Cold Front.effect: Release an expanding ice blast that deals Spirit Damage and **Slows** targets it hits.

Arctic Blast.effect: Release an expanding ice blast that deals Spirit Damage, **Freezing** and then **Slowing** targets it hits. Slowed targets have their **stamina regen frozen**

Ethereal Shift.effect: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration. Afterwards, gain a variety of temporary buffs:

Cursed Relic.effect: Curses an enemy - **interrupting, Silencing, Disarming**, and **preventing item usage**. **Removes all non-ultimate buffs**. Your own **Damage Output** is reduced for the duration.

Duration Extender.effect: Imbue an ability to increase its **Duration**.

Superior Duration.effect: Increases the **duration** of your abilities and items.

Glass Cannon.effect: Each hero kill grants **permanent Fire Rate** (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

Fury Trance.effect: Grants **Fire Rate**, **Spirit Resistance** and **Move Speed**, and removes the **Move Speed** penalty while shooting, but **Silences** you and **disables stamina usage and regeneration**.

Vampiric Burst.effect: Grants **Lifesteal**, **Fire Rate**, and **Ammo**. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

Lifestrike.effect: Your **Melee Attack** applies **Movement Slow** and **heals you** for a percentage of the **Melee Damage** dealt plus a fixed amount.
Lifestrike.note: This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

Spirit Strike.effect: When you perform a **Light or Heavy Melee** attack against a hero, deal extra Spirit Damage with the attack and reduce the target's **Spirit Resist**.
Spirit Strike.note: Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

Spirit Snatch.effect: When you perform a **Light or Heavy Melee** attack against a hero, the attack deals extra Spirit Damage and steals **Spirit Resist** and **Spirit Power**.
Spirit Snatch.note: Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

Melee Charge.effect: Your next **Heavy Melee** attack against an enemy **deals increased damage**.

Crushing Fists.effect: Your next **Heavy Melee** attack against an enemy **deals increased damage**. Your **Melee Damage** will **restore ammo** and apply a **stacking bullet resist debuff** on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be **stunned**.

Diviner's Kevlar.effect: Upon casting an **ultimate ability** gain a **Barrier** and temporary **Spirit Power**.

Radiant Regeneration.effect: Dealing Spirit Damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus Regen. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes. **Heal** and gain bonus **Movement Speed** for a short duration when you cast an ability.

Burst Fire.effect: Briefly gain **Fire Rate** and **Move Speed** when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.

Surge of Power.effect: Imbue an ability with **permanent Spirit Power**. When that ability is used, gain bonus **Move Speed** and maintain full speed while attacking.

Suppressor.effect: When you deal Spirit Damage to enemies, you also reduce their **Fire Rate**.

Quicksilver Reload.effect: Your imbued ability charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, Fire Rate, and **reloads bullets** on use.

Mercurial Magnum.effect: Your imbued ability charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, Fire Rate, and **reloads bullets** on use. Until your next reload, your **bullets deal Bonus Spirit Damage** based on your Spirit Power.

Intensifying Magazine.effect: Increases **Weapon Damage** as you continuously fire your weapon.

Escalating Resilience.effect: Grants **Bullet Resist** when your bullets hit an enemy hero. **Each shot can only grant one stack.**

Veil Walker.effect: Walking through a **cosmic veil** grants you **Stealth**, **Heal** and increased **Move Speed**.

Reactive Barrier.effect: Gain a **Barrier** when you are **Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced**.

Indomitable.effect: The next **Stun, Chain, Immobilize, Sleep or Silence** is automatically cleansed. When this happens, you gain a **barrier** and all your **ability cooldowns** get reduced by 20s%.

Restorative Shot.effect: Your next bullet will **heal** you based on what target you hit.

Split Shot.effect: Make your weapon fire **multishot**. Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a **stacking weapon damage bonus**.
Split Shot.note: Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

Active Reload.effect: While reloading, pressing [Reload] during the highlighted portion will **instantly finish your reload** and grant you **Fire Rate**, **Bullet Lifesteal** and **Move Speed**.

Magic Carpet.effect: Summon a Magic Carpet that will **fly** you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Magic Carpet.note: Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

Spirit Burn.effect: Dealing significant Spirit Damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
Spirit Burn.note: The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

Lightning Scroll.effect: Damage from your ultimate applies a Stun and deals Bonus Spirit Damage after a short delay.  **Mystic Slow effects**
Lightning Scroll.note: This effect can only trigger once per target per ultimate.

Witchmail.effect: Taking heavy hits of Spirit Damage from an enemy reduces a **random ability cooldown**.

Healing Tempo.effect: Applying Heal to yourself or an ally grants the target Fire Rate and Move Speed.
Healing Tempo.note: Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

Armor Piercer.effect: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, **piercing through** enemies and **ignoring their Bullet Resistance**.

Infinite Rounds.effect: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, **piercing through** enemies and **ignoring their Bullet Resistance**. You have **infinite** ammo.

Plated Armor.effect: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all Weapon Damage or prevent all **on-hit effects** from bullets.

Spellbreaker.effect: The next instance of high Spirit Damage you take is significantly reduced.

Juggernaut.effect: Enemies that shoot you have their **Fire Rate** slowed.

Spellslinger.effect: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.

Stalker.effect: Dealing Weapon Damage at close range opens a wound and grants you Move Speed. Wounded enemies take Spirit DPS, have reduced Bullet Resist, and are revealed **through walls**.

Express Shot.effect: Your next attack will **fire twice** in quick succession with **increased damage** and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

tiles.label: Proc Base Attack Damage Percent Alt Fire

Seraphim Wings.effect: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows **unlimited** Air Dash and Jumping.

Mystical Piano.effect: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

Nullification Burst.effect: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

Celestial Blessing.effect: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

Eternal Gift.effect: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff. Reduces your next death's respawn timer.

Mystic Conduit.effect: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies. Dealing significant **Damage** to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

Haunting Shot.effect: Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals Bonus Spirit Damage based on the target's current Health. The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

Cloak of Opportunity.effect: Block the next debuff that would apply **movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep** and become **Unstoppable**. Also gain a **Barrier** and bonus Move Speed

Runed Gauntlets.effect: Pierces through parry. Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

Electric Slippers.effect: When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.

Prism Blast.effect: You enter a void state and become **untargetable and invincible** for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

Unstable Concoction.effect: Consume a concoction that grants you **Unstoppable** and increased **speed, health, spirit and weapon damage**. After a short duration **you die and explode**, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by **50%**.

Frostbite Charm.effect: Imbued ability has its **Cooldown reduced** and gains **Spirit Power**. When the ability deals damage, **freeze** the target and apply **bonus damage**.

Shadow Strike.effect: Go **Invisible** on **Stamina use** with no detection range. Doing a **melee attack** while invisible will cause you to **steal bullet and spirit resistance** from them and deal **damage over time**.

Ballistic Enchantment.effect: Imbue an ability with increased **range**. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased **weapon damage** per **unique hero hit**. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

Recharging Rush.effect: Dealing significant Weapon Damage replenishes a charge for **each of your charged abilities**.

Golden Goose Egg.effect: Hatch the egg, gaining **souls** and **permanent buffs**. The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it. Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.

Majestic Leap.effect: **Launch** yourself high into the air and grant yourself a **Barrier**. While in the air, you can use the active again to **drop down** faster.
Majestic Leap.note: Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by an enemy hero.
